jobs.title: See our Privacy Policy
jobs.description: Privacy Policy | ActionAI ActionAI Platform Solutions Blog Company Home Platform Solutions Company Book a demo Privacy Policy Last Updated: 29 May 2025 Book a Demo Introduction Last Updated: 29 May 2025 Introduction ActionAI (“ActionAI,” “we,” or “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect through our website (the “Site”) and how we use and safeguard that information. It applies to visitors in all regions where we operate. We refer to all of the procuts we provide together with any other services including this website as “Services” in this policy. This policy also explains your choices surrounding how we use information about you, If you do not agree with this policy, do not access or use our Services or interact with any other aspect of our business. Information We Collect We collect minimal information necessary to provide our demo service: Demo Request Information: Your name and email address when you request a product demonstration Automatically Collected Data: We collect certain technical information when you visit the Site, such as your IP address, cookie identifiers, and basic usage data (for example, browser type, pages viewed, date/time of visit, and referring page) This usage data helps us understand how visitors use our Site and improve its performance. How We Use Your Information We use the collected data only for the purposes described below and not for any unrelated purposes: Demo Scheduling and Communication: Your name and email are used to schedule a product demo at your request and to follow up with you about the demo. For example, we may send a confirmation or reach out to coordinate details of the demonstration. Site Operation and Analytics: Technical data such as IP address, cookies, and usage patterns are used to maintain and analyze the performance of our Site. This helps us troubleshoot issues, monitor traffic, and understand user interactions so we can improve our website design and content. We may use third-party analytics tools (e.g., a web analytics service) to assist with this, but any such tools will be configured in compliance with privacy laws. Legal and Security: We may also process personal data if necessary to comply with legal obligations, enforce our Terms of Use, or protect the rights, property, or safety of ActionAI, our users, or others. This includes using data to prevent fraud or abuse of our services. We will not use your personal data for marketing purposes (aside from contacting you about the demo you requested) unless we obtain your consent. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. Cookies and Tracking Technologies Cookie Management ‍ We use essential cookies for site functionality and analytics cookies to understand how visitors use our site. Cookie Types: Essential: Required for demo form submission and basic site functionality Analytics: Help us understand site usage patterns (with your consent where required by law) Your Choices ‍ Most web browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies through your browser settings. However, if you disable cookies, some parts of our Site may not function properly. By continuing to use our Site without disabling cookies, you consent to our use of cookies as described in this Policy. Data Storage and Security Storage Location: Demo requests (name and email) are stored in our secure, CRM system and accessible only by authorized ActionAI personnel who need it to contact you for the demo. We ensure that regardless of where data is stored, appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your privacy. Security Measures: ActionAI takes reasonable and industry-standard precautions to protect personal data from loss, misuse, and unauthorized access. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security of information. How Long We Keep Your Data Retention: We keep personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described. If you request a demo, we will retain your contact information for as long as it’s needed to arrange the demo and follow up, or as required to fulfill any legal or reporting obligations. If you no longer want us to hold your data, you have the right to request deletion (see Your Rights below), and we will delete or anonymize your information unless we are required to keep it for legal reasons. Data Sharing and Disclosure ActionAI respects your privacy and does not share your personal data with third parties except in these limited situations: Service Providers: We may share information with trusted third-party service providers (like hosting companies or email services) who help us operate our site, bound by confidentiality obligations Legal Requirements: We may disclose personal data if required by law or to protect against fraud and protect safety Business Transfers: In the event of a merger or acquisition, personal data may be transferred with appropriate privacy protections We do not sell personal information to third parties for marketing purposes. Your Rights Depending on your location and applicable data protection laws (GDPR, California privacy laws, etc.), you may have the following rights: Right to Erasure: Request that we delete your personal data (subject to legal exceptions) Right to Object: Object to certain processing, especially for marketing purposes Right to Complain: Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at legal@ActionAI.com. We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling certain requests.
